caseNameFull: Woolley v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Elden McFarland for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy and Messrs. J. Louis Monarch and Harry Marselli for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of cer-tiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
